SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.tenantModule.selectListCountTenantModule */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM TENANT_MODULE WHERE 1=1
AND TENANT_ID like '%${scTenantId}%'
AND MODULE_ID like '%${scModuleId}%'
AND PURCHASED_AT like '%${scPurchasedAt}%'

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.tenantModule.selectTenantModuleDetails */ tm.tenant_id as tenantId, tm.module_id as moduleId, tm.purchased_at as purchasedAt, m.code as code, m.name as name, m.description as description, m.icon as icon FROM TENANT_MODULE tm INNER JOIN MODULE m ON tm.module_id = m.module_id WHERE tm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY tm.purchased_at DESC, m.name
